# Bonatto

> Software Engineer writing about programming languages, systems, type theory, and other technical subjects.

This site contains static HTML pages with the complete text of each post.

## Blog

- [Blog](https://fibonatto.github.io/): Full-text static version of the blog.
- [RSS](https://fibonatto.github.io/rss.xml): RSS feed for new posts.

## Posts

- [The Speed of Light and the Illusion of Infinite Intelligence](https://fibonatto.github.io/post/speed-of-light-illusion-of-infinite-intelligence.html): Why bigger models alone won't solve the problems of AI reliability, and why we need better architecture instead.

- [Context as a Risk Variable](https://fibonatto.github.io/post/context-as-a-risk-variable.html): A mathematical formulation for why more context does not imply more reliability in systems with LLMs
